description:
This endpoint allows updating various receipt header properties including status, signature,
received by name, received at timestamp, shipment reference, delivery location, and related document associations.
It also supports adding, updating, and removing dynamic properties.
When transitioning a receipt to Final status for a PO that originates from a commitment (order_type_id == 2),
an invoice (requisition) will be created in Procore for the received quantities.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the receipt to update.

notes.description: Notes associated with the document header.

signature.description: The signature to update on the receipt.

received_by_id.description: The id of the user who received the receipt. Clears field if value is empty string or "-1".

received_at.description: The timestamp when the receipt was received.

shipment_reference.description: The reference metadata for the shipment.

delivery_location.description: The location ID of the delivery location. Clears field if value is empty string or -1.

order_id.description: The related order ID associated with the receipt.

shipment_id.description: The related shipment ID associated with the receipt.
